name: AWS GuardDuty Benchmark
description: Amazon GuardDuty is an intelligence threat detection service that provides accurate, continuous monitoring to protect AWS accounts and workloads. The Sumo Logic Amazon GuardDuty Benchmark App integrates Sumo Logic Global Intelligence Service (GIS) with Amazon GuardDuty for continuous machine learning and statistical baselines for KPIs (key performance indicators) and KRIs (key risk indicators). These baselines enable you to optimize security configuration and threat detection on all your AWS accounts. The App includes preconfigured dashboards and searches with visual displays for global threat baselines and real-time threat detection across your AWS environment.

children.name: 01. Amazon GuardDuty Global Baseline
children.description: Amazon GuardDuty Global Baseline dashboard provides a high-level baseline of  threats across Sumo Logic customers. Panels display graphs for threat and severity distribution, targeted resources, and detailed information on rare medium and high severity threats.

panels.name: Threat Mix: ALL Threats (log scale)
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty | where threatpurpose!="eps" | parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop | fields -_some_matched| percentage * 100 as percentage //| where threatpurpose!="Recon"
| sum(percentage) by threatpurpose, threatname | transpose row threatpurpose column threatname

panels.name: Threat Mix: RARE Threats (log scale)
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty | where threatpurpose!="eps" | parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop | fields -_some_matched| percentage * 100 as percentage 
| where percentage <0.2
| sum(percentage) by threatpurpose, threatname | transpose row threatpurpose column threatname

panels.name: Threat Sources by Geography
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty_geo 
| sum(percentage) as _count by sourcelat, sourcelon
| sourcelat as latitude
| sourcelon as longitude
| toInt(_count * 100) as _count
| fields longitude, latitude, _count
| sort by _count asc

panels.name: Threat Sources and Targets by  Geography
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty_geo
| sum(percentage) as percentage by threatpurpose, threatname, sourcelat, sourcelon, destinationlat, destinationlon
| topk(3, percentage) group by threatpurpose

panels.name: Threat Share: Targeted Resource Type
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty | where threatpurpose!="eps" | parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop | fields -_some_matched| percentage * 100 as percentage
| sum(percentage) by resource
| round(_sum)

panels.name: Threat Share: Severity
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty | where threatpurpose!="eps" | parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop | fields -_some_matched| percentage * 100 as percentage
| if (severity="2", "2 - Low", if(severity="5", "5 - Medium", "8 - High")) as severity
| sum(percentage) by severity 
| sort -severity
| round(_sum)

panels.name: Threat Mix: ALL Threats (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "type" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName 
| count as threatCount by ThreatPurpose,ThreatName
| total threatCount
| (threatCount / _total) * 100 as percentage
| fields - threatCount, _total
| transpose row ThreatPurpose column ThreatName

panels.name: Threat Mix: RARE Threats (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty*
| json field=_raw "id", "type","severity" ,"title","description", "accountId", "resource.resourceType", "region"

| toint(severity) as sev
//| where sev>2 
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatPurpose, targetResource, threatName
| count by threatPurpose, threatName, targetResource, sev
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatPurpose, threatname=threatName, severity=sev, resource=targetresource
| if(global_percent=0, 0.000001, global_percent) as global_percent
| total _count as totalevents | _count/totalevents as percentage
| total global_percent as total_global_percent
| where global_percent<.002
| sum(percentage) by ThreatPurpose,ThreatName
| _sum * 100 as percentage
| fields - _sum
| transpose row threatPurpose column threatName

panels.name: Threat Sources by Geography
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* (geoLocation and lat and lon)
| parse "\"countryName\":\"*\"}," as countryName nodrop
| if(isEmpty(countryName), "Unknown", countryName) as countryName
| count as threatCount by countryName
| total threatCount as threattotal
| threatCount/threattotal as threatPercentage
| fields countryName
| benchmark percentage, sourcelat, sourcelon from guardduty on countryName
| sum(percentage) as _count by sourcelat, sourcelon
| sourcelat as latitude
| sourcelon as longitude
| toInt(_count * 100) as _count
| fields longitude, latitude, _count
| sort by _count asc

panels.name: Threat Sources and Targets by Geography
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* (geoLocation and lat and lon)
| parse "\"severity\":*," as severity
| parse "\"type\":\"*\"," as type
| parse regex field=type "(?<threatPurpose>\w+):(?<resource>\w+)/(?<threatName>.*)"
| parse "\"region\":\"*\"," as region
| parse "\"countryName\":\"*\"}," as countryName nodrop
| if(isEmpty(countryName), "Unknown", countryName) as countryName
| parse regex field=threatName "(?<threatFamily>[^.]*)(?:\.(?<threatVariant>[^!]*))?(?:!(?<threatArtifact>.*))" nodrop
| count as threatCount by threatName, threatPurpose, region, countryName
| total threatCount as threattotal
| threatCount/threattotal as threatPercentage
| fields threatName, threatPurpose, region, countryName
| benchmark percentage, sourcelat, sourcelon, destinationlat, destinationlon from guardduty on threatName, countryName, region
| sum(percentage) as percentage by threatpurpose, threatname, sourcelat, sourcelon, destinationlat, destinationlon
| topk(3, percentage) group by threatpurpose

panels.name: Share: Resource Type
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "type" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| count by ResourceType 
//| transpose row severity column resourceType

panels.name: Share: Severity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty*
| json field=_raw "accountId", "region", "partition", "id", "arn", "type","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| count by severity
| where !isNull(severity)
| sort _count

panels.name: Threats by AccountID (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "accountId", "region", "partition", "id", "arn", "type","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop
| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId,"\"groupId\":\"*\"" as securityGroupId,"\"tags\":[*]" as tags,"\"groupName\":\"*\"" as securityGroupName nodrop
| json field=_raw "resource.instanceDetails.instanceId" as instanceid nodrop
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| count as count accountId
| sort by count

panels.name: Threats by InstanceID (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "resource.instanceDetails.instanceId" as instance_id nodrop
| count as count instance_id | sort by count

panels.name: Threats by Security Group (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "accountId", "region", "partition", "id", "arn", "type","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop
| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId,"\"groupId\":\"*\"" as securityGroupId,"\"tags\":[*]" as tags,"\"groupName\":\"*\"" as securityGroupName nodrop
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| concat(securityGroupName,"-",securityGroupId) as SecurityGroup
| where SecurityGroup<>"-"
| count as count SecurityGroup
| sort by count

children.name: 03. My Company v. Global Baseline: ALL Threats
children.description: My Company v. Global Baseline: ALL Threats dashboard compares your AWS environment against all Sumo Logic customers. The posture score (0=HIGH RISK, 100=LOW RISK) is a composite view of risk associated with GuardDuty findings and is impacted by severity, number of findings, deviation from global baseline and rarity of threats within Sumo Logic customers. The Relative Impact panel unpacks the score into the contributing threats ordered by their impact on the posture score. My Prioritized Action Plan lists the change management actions in order of impact on GuardDuty security posture. Finally, the trendline and associated One Day change display impact of change management on your posture.

panels.name: My Company v. Global Threat Mix (log scale)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* | json "type" | parse field=type "*:" as purpose | count by purpose | total _count as numevents 
| _count / numevents as percent | fields purpose, percent
| benchmark percentage as global from guardduty on threatPurpose=purpose
| if(global=0, 0.000001, global) as global
// ratio
| sort percent
| 100* global as global_baseline | 100* percent as my_company | fields purpose, my_company, global_baseline

panels.name: Posture Score
panels.queryString: benchscore score from guardduty | round(score * 100) / 100 as score

panels.name: Relative Impact on Posture Score
panels.queryString: benchscore contribution from guardduty | fields - severity | total contribution as _total | (contribution/_total) as rel_score_impact |  fields - _total,contribution | sum(rel_score_impact) as rel_score_impact by threatpurpose | sort by rel_score_impact desc

panels.name: My Prioritized Action Plan
panels.queryString:
benchscore finding from guardduty | 
resource as resourcetype | 
sum(priorityscore) as score_impact by threatpurpose, threatname, severity, resourcetype,  region, sourcelat, sourcelon, destinationlat, destinationlon, count |
total score_impact as _total | (score_impact / _total) as score_impact |
fields threatpurpose, threatname, severity, count, score_impact, resourcetype,  region | 
urlencode(format("_sourceCategory = *guardduty*|json field=_raw \"id\",\"type\",\"severity\",\"title\",\"description\",\"accountId\",\"resource.resourceType\",\"region\"|parse field=type \"*:*/*\" as threatPurpose, targetResource, threatName | where (threatPurpose=\"%s\" AND targetResource=\"%s\" AND sev=\"%s\" AND threatName=\"%s\")", threatpurpose, resourcetype ,severity,threatname)) as search_query |
format ("https://service%ssumologic.com/ui/#/search/@%d,%d@%s",{{RegionCode}}, querystarttime(),queryendtime(),search_query) as search_query_link |
tourl(search_query_link,"Click Here") as link_to_findings |
fields - search_query, search_query_link | 
sort by score_impact

children.name: 04. My Company v. Global Baseline: RARE Threats
children.description: My Company v. Global Baseline: RARE Threats dashboard rare threats in your AWS environment versus a baseline of global threats, paired with detailed information on severity all Sumo Logic customers. Rare threats are those that account for 0.2% of less share of findings in the Sumo Logic population. As such, rare threats present in your AWS environment merit immediate attention.

panels.name: My Company RARE Threats Mix v. Global Baseline
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty*
| json field=_raw "type","severity"
| toint(severity) as sev
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatPurpose, targetResource, threatName
| count by threatPurpose, threatName, targetResource, sev
| total _count as totalevents 
| _count/totalevents as my_company_percentage
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatPurpose, threatname=threatName, severity=sev, resource=targetresource
| if(global_percent=0, 0.000001, global_percent) as global_percent
| where global_percent<.002
| sum(my_company_percentage) as my_company, sum(global_percent) as global_baseline by ThreatPurpose 
| my_company * 100 as my_company
| global_baseline * 100 as global_baseline
| sort my_company
| fields ThreatPurpose, my_company, global_baseline

panels.name: Rare Threats
panels.queryString:
benchscore contribution from guardduty | toint(severity) as severity | max(contribution) as contribution by threatname, threatpurpose, severity, resource
|where [subquery: _sourceCategory = *guardduty*
// PARSE
| json field=_raw "id", "type","severity" ,"title","description"
| toint(severity) as severity
//| where sev>2
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose, resource, threatname
| count by threatpurpose, threatname, resource, severity
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatpurpose, threatname=threatname, severity=severity, resource=resource
| if(global_percent=0, 0.000001, global_percent) as global_percent
| total _count as totalevents | _count/totalevents as percentage
| total global_percent as total_global_percent
| where global_percent<.002
| count by threatpurpose, threatname, severity, resource
| compose threatpurpose, threatname]
| count

panels.name: Rare Event Trendline
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty*
// PARSE
| json field=_raw "id", "type","severity" ,"title","description"
| toint(severity) as sev
//| where sev>2 
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatPurpose, targetResource, threatName
| timeslice 24h  
| count by _timeslice, threatPurpose, threatName, targetResource, sev
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatPurpose, threatname=threatName, severity=sev, resource=targetresource
| if(global_percent=0, 0.000001, global_percent) as global_percent
| if (sev >= 7, concat(sev," - High") , if (sev >= 4 , concat(sev," - Medium"), concat(sev," - Low"))) as severity
| total _count as totalevents | _count/totalevents as percentage
| total global_percent as total_global_percent
| where global_percent<.002
| count by _timeslice

panels.name: All Threats  - Timeline
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* accountId region
| json field=_raw "accountId","region","partition","id","arn","type","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| json field=_raw "resource.resourceType","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action" as resourceType,serviceName, detectorId, action nodrop 
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice
| outlier _count window=5,threshold=3,consecutive=2,direction=+

panels.name: Threats by Region -  Timeline
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *guardduty* 
| json field=_raw "accountId", "region", "partition", "id", "arn", "type","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as  localPort nodrop
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4" as ip nodrop
| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId,"\"groupId\":\"*\"" as securityGroupId,"\"tags\":[*]" as tags,"\"groupName\":\"*\"" as securityGroupName nodrop
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| timeslice 15m
| count by _timeslice, region
| transpose row _timeslice column region

| json field=_raw "accountId", "region", "partition", "id", "arn", "type","service.serviceName","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description" nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop
| json field=%service.action "awsApiCallAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4" as ip nodrop
| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId,"\"groupId\":\"*\"" as securityGroupId,"\"tags\":[*]" as tags,"\"groupName\":\"*\"" as securityGroupName nodrop
| json field=_raw "resource.instanceDetails.instanceId" as instanceid nodrop
| if(severity=0, "Info",if(severity=2, "Low", if(severity=5, "Medium", if(severity=8, "High",if(severity=9.5, "Critical",severity))))) as severity
| if(!isNull(instanceid),concat ("https://",region,".console.aws.amazon.com/ec2/v2/home?region=",region,"#Instances:search=",instanceid),"") as link
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.geoLocation.lon" as longitude nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as ThreatPurpose,ResourceType,ThreatName
| count as count by ThreatPurpose,severity
| transpose row severity column ThreatPurpose
